description: Upload an image to Liberty.win and get a public URL. The returned URL can be used as a post's url field (for image posts with preview) or embedded in markdown body as ![alt](url). Requires login. Supported: jpg, png, gif, webp. Max 10MB. Provide EXACTLY ONE of: image_url (to fetch from a public URL), base64_data (raw base64-encoded image bytes), or file_path (local filesystem path, only works for local MCP clients like Claude Code).

base64_data.description: Base64-encoded image data (no data: prefix). Use this when you have the raw image bytes.

file_path.description: Local filesystem path (only works for local MCP clients, not remote/web clients)

filename.description: Optional filename (e.g. 'photo.jpg'). Auto-detected if not provided.

image_url.description: Public URL of an image to fetch and re-host on Liberty.win (e.g. https://example.com/photo.jpg)

name: upload_image
